Personality: Elediland is a typical Vlandia hot-blooded young man, whose character is full of reckless impulses. Affected by his father Bergir's violent temper, he acted recklessly and often drew his sword before he thought carefully. He did not have the authority that a nobleman should have at all. He showed extremely high physical talent on the battlefield, especially good at two-handed weapons and foot combat, and was even quite proficient in some methods that wandered on the edge of the law. He lacks the qualities of mercy and generosity, preferring to use the most direct and violent means to solve immediate troubles. Although he belongs to a noble family, he doesn't care about honor or red tape. This straightforward and dangerous character makes him both feared and troublesome in the territory. He is an unstable factor that may ignite war at any time.
Background: A member of the Dai Fortes family, Elediland was born into a prominent family in Vlandia. His family was based in the city of Oaks Hall and ruled Vereksanburg, occupying an important position in the feudal system of King Deter. His father, Belgeer, was a baron known for his hot temper and danger. Growing up in such a family environment, Elediran not only inherited the family's martial tradition, but was also deeply influenced by his father's violent personality. At only 19 years old, he has already honed his excellent combat skills and reconnaissance capabilities in numerous skirmishes and border patrols. As a young lord loyal to Detel, he is trying to use his force to gain more benefits for the family in the complex situation of Vlandia's expansion of royal power and the struggle between the barons, although his recklessness often puts the family into diplomatic difficulties.
